issue: Review PR adding new API endpoints

observations.summary: unitPrice validation allowed NaN and Infinity values
observations.detail: The isValidOrderItem function used typeof === 'number' to validate unitPrice, which passes for NaN and Infinity since typeof NaN === 'number'. Fixed by adding Number.isFinite() check. This matches the existing convention documented in repository memory: 'numeric validation must use Number.isFinite() for user-supplied values'.

observations.summary: canModifyOrder renamed to canAccessOrder for accuracy
observations.detail: The function canModifyOrder was used for both read (GET) and write (PUT/DELETE) operations, making its name misleading. Renamed to canAccessOrder to better reflect its actual purpose of gating both view and modify access.

observations.summary: Removed unsafe 'as any' cast in update route
observations.detail: The update route constructed a changes object as Record<string, unknown> then cast it as any to pass to orderStore.update(). Replaced with properly typed Partial<Pick<Order, 'items' | 'status'>> and imported Order type at module level instead of using inline import().

observations.summary: Added 3 new edge case tests bringing total to 47
observations.detail: Added tests for: (1) NaN unitPrice rejection, (2) Infinity unitPrice rejection, (3) simultaneous items and status update. These cover validation edge cases and a combined update path that was previously untested.

observations.summary: Order endpoints follow { data, meta } envelope consistently
observations.detail: All order endpoints correctly use the { data: T, meta?: { ... } } response envelope and { error: { code, message } } error format matching the documented /api/products convention. Auth endpoints still use a different raw format, creating an inconsistency across the API that should be addressed separately.
